newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy budget voting seen finished by 1200 GMT Sat.
newsitem.headline: Italy budget voting seen finished by 1200 GMT Sat.

text.p: Ratification of the government's 1997 budget should be completed by the lower house of parliament by 1200 GMT on Saturday, chamber speaker Luciano Violante said.
The government has said it will apply to put the lira back into the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM) once the budget law has been approved by the lower house.
Most analysts believe the lira will return to the ERM before the European Union's Dublin summit on December 13-14.

In the early hours of Friday the lower house approved the main core of the three-pronged budget package and has already completed voting on all the articles in one of the remaining two sections of the bill.
"We will finish the whole thing by 1 p.m (local)," Violante said. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
